articles.title: SWITCHING LLMS MID-CONVERSATION IS A SKI-RENTAL PROBLEM
articles.summary: Most work on routing between language models is centered on making sure the right model handles the right request. A classifier scores the request, then the request is routed to a cheap model if it is easy, and a frontier model if it is hard. For coding agents, this is only half of the problem. The second half of the problem is knowing when a running session should change model. This problem, which this post discusses, has a classic form: the ski-rental problem.

WHY ANTIGRAVITY EATS WEEKLY QUOTA FAST - AND WHAT I MEASURED
articles.summary: Google Antigravity wipes users' prompt caches if there is a 5-minute pause. Refreshing the cache just before expiry works, but only for 3 pings. Even a 5-word prompt starts with 13,800 to 16,800+ tokens of system instructions, MCP schemas, and skills. Disabling unused MCP servers and plugins shrinks cold turns and cache misses.

articles.title: CONTEXT API EXTRACTS FULL CONTEXT FROM ANY WEB PAGE
articles.summary: The Perplexity Context API can extract the full context from any webpage and return clean Markdown, links, and relevant passages. It can read up to 10 URLs at once. Agents can specify the freshness of each request and validate the source of each result. Every successful result also includes metadata for the page such as the title, description, language, author, and date of publication.

articles.title: INTRODUCING MODEL FACTORY
articles.summary: Model Factory is a training loop that lets any company train, deploy, and continuously improve models in production. It brings reinforcement learning, supervised fine-tuning, pre-training, and inference together into one control plane. It also offers health checks, automatic node replacement, and recovery from the latest checkpoint for long-running experiments. Model Factory has already been deployed for teams working on finance automation, computer use, scientific discovery, chip design, and other industries.

articles.title: QUICKLY, THERE'S NO TIME
articles.summary: Many things point to the substantial possibility of superintelligence arriving next year. Any plan to prepare for this has to be ready for the full automation of AI R&D, which will result in the rapid advancement of AI abilities beyond human levels. It will need to include mechanisms to slow down the resulting growth in capabilities.

articles.title: THE SILENT CONSENSUS
articles.summary: The most common vision for the future that AI brings isn't totally positive. It is often left unsaid, discernible only by implication, a silent consensus. The decisions humans make will likely lead to a world in which people have forfeited effective authority over much of our civilization. Even if we make extraordinary progress on AI safety and alignment, we could still find ourselves having submitted to a machine entity.
